items.title: Removal of Japanese Ho-Ri SPGs from the Research Tree and Sale
items.summary: Today, we’d like to give you a heads up regarding the removal of the Japanese Ho-Ri Production and Ho-Ri Prototype SPGs from the Japanese research tree and from sale respectively.

items.title: Update 2.57.1.70
items.summary: Scimitar Mk.2 — vehicle mass has been reduced from 13 tons to 12.26 tons. (Report). The rear view mirrors have been removed.

items.title: Update 2.57.1.67
items.summary: A bug that sometimes caused the button for switching to the nuke carrying aircraft to not show up in the action bar in Ground Battles has been fixed.

items.title: Work-In-Progress: New Decals and QoL Features
items.summary: Today we’d like to cover some quality of life improvements for decals, and show you some of the new decals we’ve been working on.

items.title: How Was the Year in War Thunder: Rate the New Additions
